validatorVerdict: validator-8 ACCEPT wp/w4h-27-compose-comes-up at e3b954880 (R5; verdict-w4h-27.txt sha256 ecc53642a671a58b4a458eda0b1f620b342083fa6e499915ac5231e672092f59, append-only; copied as w4h-27-validation.txt). Earlier: REJECT at 713593038 (F1 the commits carried the user's personal email from the worktree config; F2 `fleet up` recreated the shared pool and restarted the supervisor on a running fleet; verdict-w4h-27-at-713593038.txt d79ded2a15eba38e, redacted by validator-8: the address replaced by a placeholder) and the R4 ACCEPT at b26a63460 (verdict-w4h-27-at-b26a63460.txt 9f30740c32e511bd) superseded when the merge commit's hook timed out on the purge case.
rejectionsAndReauthoring: F1: the 7 commits were re-authored with the archy noreply address, trees unchanged (r4-trees.txt); integrator-5's identity-check (commits) is now the first leg of every package commit and of every receipts set. g7AndN3: the W16 G7 Compose proof passed on @swc/core 1.16.2 (a plain addon); 1.16.13 (a carrier needing an executable user cache) arrived with merge 7247f7e9a; option (c) ruled: the shipped-isolation guard (scripts/check-factory-image-shipped-config.ts) and the ci.yml job factory-image-shipped-isolation start the image under the flags the Compose profile ships. N3: the local fleet declares NO default release profile; the reference S3 adapter's placeholder digest is refused by name (factory_release_adapter_unpublished); the release block is written whenever release profiles exist (S3 always, GitHub only when declared), none without a profile.

notes:
For the W4H-27 merge.json (integrator-5, recorded 2026-10-14 on the coordinator's order):
- hookTimeoutFinding: "a fixed per-test hook budget met a test whose cost came from its neighbours' residue; fixed at the root, not by raising
  the cap". The first commit try at b26a63460 (2026-10-14T02:11:44Z - 02:17:43Z) was refused by the pre-commit hook: tests/postgres/factory-
  provisioning.test.ts "teardown and purge > purge needs an installation-issued approval and closed work, drops the databases, and keeps the
  archive key" timed out at 38.6 s against the hook's 30 s (62 pass, 1 fail; nothing committed; integ restored). Measured under the lock on an
  own pg (ruling (b)): inside the whole file, base bea35538d (= main 1981febd2 code) 30.91 s / 30.83 s, head b26a63460 30.48 s / 30.45 s;
  the case alone (-t) about 1.0 s at both. Head = base, both over the budget: a pre-existing test-hygiene defect (the 62 earlier tests'
  leftover databases). Ruling (e): no re-run, no skip, no cap change; the owner made the case independent of the file's residue, red-first by
  a database-set assertion; validator-8 re-checked the changed test. Evidence: purge-measure/ (measure.sh v2, full1..4 logs and junit).
- measurementSlip: measure.sh v1's return-to-integ trap was replaced by own_pg_start's own EXIT trap; the integ worktree stayed detached at
  b26a63460 (clean) about 30 s; checked back out, traps chained; no lasting effect (accepted by the coordinator).
- caseCheckScopeDefect (integrator-5's tool, ruled 2026-10-14): the hold at d4f1c6b0f ended HEAVY DONE status=1 from ONE leg, red-first-cases,
  while all 22 named cases passed: case-check.sh v6 (i) judged the changed SOURCE lines against the test-file-only lcov (44 lines in
  compose-profile/fleet/host/deployment/fleet-cli/check-…-config.ts; covered by the pg and producer legs; the merge gates' patch PASSED over
  11 files on the full merged lcov) and (ii) bound scripts/factory-orchestrator-coverage.sh (a producer script, run by the orchestrator-node
  leg, not under the tests' trace). Fixed: case-check.sh v7 d3fdc21d487a58b5 (lines on changed *.test.ts only; BASH_LINE_EXCLUDE for
  scripts/*-coverage.sh), bash-line-cover.py v2 767e675453ecd968; both exclusions self-tested; the ONE leg re-run under the lock against
  d4f1c6b0f: exit 0, 22/22, test lines covered, no in-scope .sh (heavy-red-first-cases-rerun.log).
